extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants, grantee institutions, institutional administrators, and NIH staff
extracted.subtask_description: Table of contents / comprehensive policy statement defining terms, requirements, conditions, and program-specific rules governing NIH grants and cooperative agreements effective Oct 1, 1998. Used to determine eligibility, allowability of costs, reporting, human subjects protections, intellectual property, and award administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility (general): who may apply for NIH grants and cooperative agreements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears across Parts I and II and in program-specific sections (e.g., NRSA, construction, SBIR/STTR, foreign awards). Includes institutional and individual eligibility rules and citizenship requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of Applications / Application Forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Types of Applications and required Application Forms (Table 1: Required Forms for Competing Applications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies which application types and standardized forms are required for competing applications, plus guidance on application submission and availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Receipt Points and Deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Application receipt points and deadlines for submission of applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines where and when applications must be received; affects acceptability and timeliness of proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal Implication of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal implications arising from submission of an application to NIH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outlines legal responsibilities and potential consequences associated with application submission (e.g., representations, certifications).

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality of Information (Proprietary Information)
rubrics_metrics.description: Confidentiality and handling of proprietary information contained in applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on what information is protected, limitations, and procedures for treating proprietary material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer Review Process
rubrics_metrics.description: The Peer Review Process including Initial Review, National Advisory Council or Board Review, Appeals of Initial Scientific Review, and Disposition of Applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes stages of review, criteria applied, how appeals are handled, and disposition options following peer review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support Mechanisms / Funding Opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Support mechanisms and descriptions of available funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains program mechanisms (grants, cooperative agreements, etc.) and where to find opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completing the Preaward Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Steps and requirements for completing the preaward process prior to issuing an award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes application review outcome processing, award negotiation, and prerequisites before Notice of Grant Award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding principles that guide NIH in awarding support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General principles used to allocate and prioritize funds (contextual guidance for award decisions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Analysis and Assessment of Management Systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of applicant cost proposals and review of institutional financial/management systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NIH evaluates costs proposed and the adequacy of grantee management systems as part of award decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of Terms and Conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of standard terms and conditions that will govern NIH grant awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets expectations for awardees on enforceable provisions included in awards and how special conditions may be applied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Policy Requirements and Objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Public policy requirements and objectives that apply to NIH grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerates policy areas (e.g., civil rights, environmental, human subjects) and cross-cutting federal requirements applicable to awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethical and Safe Conduct in Science and Organizational Operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards governing ethical and safe conduct in scientific research and institutional operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes conduct expectations, safety practices, and institutional responsibilities to ensure ethical research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict of Interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing conflicts of interest for investigators and institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements for disclosure, management, and mitigation of financial or other conflicts that could bias research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debarment and Suspension
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on debarment and suspension that can bar entities or individuals from receiving federal funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and criteria for debarment/suspension actions and their effect on grant eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drug-Free Workplace
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement for maintaining a drug-free workplace under federal awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obligations of grantees to prohibit unlawful manufacture, distribution, dispensing, possession, or use of controlled substances in the workplace.

rubrics_metrics.name: Health and Safety Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Health and safety requirements applicable to NIH-funded activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes institutional responsibilities, safety plans, and compliance with applicable health and safety standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation on Use of Funds for Promotion or Legalization of Controlled Substances
rubrics_metrics.description: Restrictions on using grant funds for activities promoting or legalizing controlled substances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies prohibited uses of NIH funds related to controlled substance promotion/legalization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lobbying
rubrics_metrics.description: Restrictions and disclosure rules regarding lobbying using federal grant funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines prohibited lobbying activities and reporting/disclosure requirements (see also Lobbying Disclosure).

rubrics_metrics.name: Misconduct in Science
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies addressing allegations and handling of scientific misconduct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for reporting, investigating, and responding to misconduct, and potential sanctions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nondelinquency on Federal Debt
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that grantees not be delinquent on federal debt.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-delinquency may be a condition of eligibility or continued support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recombinant DNA and Institutional Biosafety Committees
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements regarding recombinant DNA work and oversight by Institutional Biosafety Committees (IBCs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expectations for compliance with NIH guidelines for recombinant DNA research and local IBC review/approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restrictions on Distribution of Sterile Needles
rubrics_metrics.description: Restrictions related to distribution of sterile needles under NIH-supported activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies limitations/conditions where needle distribution may be prohibited or regulated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Smoke-Free Workplace and Seat Belt Use
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy expectations for smoke-free workplaces and seat belt use at institutions receiving NIH funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NIH encourages or requires grantees to adopt these safety-promoting policies where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements Affecting Rights and Welfare of Individuals as Research Subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements to protect rights and welfare of human subjects, patients, or recipients of services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encompasses human subjects protections, confidentiality, IND requirements, and related obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ban on Human Embryo Research and Cloning
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy banning certain types of human embryo research and cloning activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies prohibited activities and any applicable exceptions or procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality of Patient Records / Protection of Research Subjects' Identity
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements to maintain confidentiality of patient records and protect subjects' identity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and legal obligations (e.g., HIPAA-related considerations) to guard privacy of subject data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Controlled Substances and Investigational New Drug (IND) Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Regulations addressing use of controlled substances and requirements for IND applications in research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compliance with FDA/DEA rules when studies involve investigational drugs or controlled substances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pro-Children Act of 1994
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicability of the Pro-Children Act's restrictions (e.g., smoking near children) to NIH-funded programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grantees must comply with statutory protections for children in program activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Women and Minorities as Subjects in Clinical Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement for inclusion of women and minorities in NIH-funded clinical research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policies require appropriate inclusion or justification for exclusion, and associated reporting and recruitment plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Children as Subjects in Clinical Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements concerning inclusion of children as research subjects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on when children must be included or appropriately justified as excluded, plus protections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civil Rights and Anti-Discrimination Statutes
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicability of Age Discrimination Act, Civil Rights Act, Education Amendments (Title IX), Rehabilitation Act, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grantees must comply with federal non-discrimination laws in program delivery and employment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental Impact and Facility Construction Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Environmental impact, acquisition/alteration/renovation, and construction-related policy requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes NEPA, flood insurance, historic properties, seismic safety, life safety, plumbing/electrical, and other facility standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of Information / Acknowledgment of Federal Funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for availability of information and acknowledgment of NIH federal funding in publications and materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies how to acknowledge support and make certain information available to the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) and The Privacy Act
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicability of FOIA and the Privacy Act to records created or held under NIH awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains public access to records and privacy protections for personally identifiable information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metric System / Other Administrative Public Policy Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous public policy requirements such as use of the Metric System, military recruiting access, Year 2000 compliance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists additional cross-cutting federal requirements that grantees must follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Grant Award (NGA)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Notice of Grant Award as the official instrument authorizing funds and specifying award terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NGA content, how it is issued, and how it governs the award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding, Budget, and Additional Terms and Conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding allocations, approved budget items, and special/additional terms and conditions of awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements for adhering to the approved budget, and implications of special award conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment and Cash Management (SMARTLINK II/ACH, CASHLINE/ACH, Monthly Cash Request)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and systems for payment and cash management under NIH awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies electronic payment systems, cash advance/request procedures, and interest on advances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interest Earned on Advances of Grant Funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for interest earned on advances of federal funds and how interest must be handled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treatment of interest (crediting, remitting, or use) according to federal cash management rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: The federal cost principles that govern allowability and allocability of costs charged to awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General cost allowability standards and references to applicable OMB/Cost Circulars.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct Costs and Facilities and Administrative (Indirect) Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and treatment of direct costs and F&A (indirect) costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on budgeted direct-cost items and institutional F&A rate application and documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of Costs/Activities (Selected Items of Cost)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific guidance on which costs and activities are allowable or unallowable under NIH awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes examples of selected items of cost, treatment of fringe benefits, travel, equipment, tuition, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Transfers, Overruns, Accelerated and Delayed Expenditures
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing cost transfers, budget overruns, and accelerated/delayed spending patterns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements for documentation, prior approvals, and allowable adjustments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allocation of Costs and Closely Related Work; Applicable Credits
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles for allocating costs among projects and accounting for applicable credits to awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How to allocate shared costs and credit unallowable receipts to awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Services Provided by Affiliated Organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Treatment of services provided by affiliate organizations to grantees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on charging for services, valuation, and documentation of affiliate transactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative obligations associated with managing NIH grants (e.g., changes, prior approvals, requests).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for requests for approval, expanded authorities, noncompeting continuations, and streamlined processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Changes in Project and Budget; Prior Approval Requirements; Expanded Authorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for when changes in scope/project or budget require NIH prior approval and what can be done under expanded authorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines thresholds and processes for requesting approvals or exercising expanded authorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Noncompeting Continuation Awards and Streamlined Noncompeting Award Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and criteria for noncompeting continuation awards and options for streamlined processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporting and review requirements for renewing funding periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rights in Data (Publication and Copyrighting) and Unique Research Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies on rights in data, publication, copyright, and sharing of unique research resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expectations for publication, data sharing, and stewardship of unique resources generated with NIH funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions and Patents; Invention Reporting; Final Invention Statement and Certification
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for reporting inventions, patent rights, and final invention certifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obligations under Bayh-Dole and NIH policies for disclosure, protection, licensing, and reporting of inventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management Systems and Procedures (Financial Management System Standards)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for grantee financial management systems and administrative procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required controls, accounting systems, and documentation practices to manage federal funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Income and Reporting of Program Income
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for handling and reporting program income generated under awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Methods of disposition (additive, deductive, cost sharing) and reporting requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Property Management System Standards (Real Property, Equipment and Supplies, Exempt/Nonexempt Property)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for management, use, and disposition of real property, equipment, and supplies acquired with award funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Title, inventory, allowable use, disposition procedures, and classifications (exempt vs nonexempt).

rubrics_metrics.name: Revocable License
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules concerning revocable licenses for government interests in property or facility use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Circumstances under which revocable licenses may be used and management requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procurement System Standards and Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards governing procurement systems used by grantees to acquire goods and services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes approval requirements, competitive procedures, documentation, and contracting with small/minority/women-owned businesses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contracting With Small Businesses, Minority-Owned Firms, and Women's Business Enterprises
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and encouragements for contracting with small, minority-owned, and women-owned businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procurement obligations to promote these businesses and related reporting/monitoring.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring, Reporting, and Progress Reports as Part of Noncompeting Continuation Requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitoring and reporting obligations including progress reports tied to continuation funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frequency and content expectations for progress reporting and program monitoring.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Reports; Unobligated Balances and Actual Expenditures
rubrics_metrics.description: Financial reporting requirements, treatment of unobligated balances and accounting for actual expenditures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schedules, formats, and substantiation required for financial reporting to NIH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report to the Office of Research Integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligation to report certain matters (e.g., research misconduct) to the Office of Research Integrity (ORI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Circumstances that trigger ORI reporting and procedural obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lobbying Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure requirements related to lobbying activities connected to federal awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporting thresholds and forms/procedures for disclosing lobby-related expenditures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record Retention and Access
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements to retain records and provide access to records created under NIH awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Retention periods, access rights for auditors and NIH, and procedures at closeout.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit
rubrics_metrics.description: Audit requirements and standards applicable to recipients of NIH funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audit frequency, scope, compliance with OMB circulars, and consequences of audit findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enforcement Actions; Suspension, Termination, Withholding of Support; Recovery of Funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Possible enforcement actions for noncompliance including suspension, termination, withholding support, and fund recovery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and grounds for enforcement actions and mechanisms for debt collection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closeout; Final Reports (Final Financial Status Report, Final Progress Report, Final Invention Statement and Certification)
rubrics_metrics.description: Closeout procedures and required final reports at the end of an award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deadlines and required content for final financial, progress, and invention reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant Appeals Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures available to applicants/recipients to appeal adverse decisions regarding grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timelines, grounds for appeal, and processes for resolution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Construction Grants: Eligibility, Review and Approval
rubrics_metrics.description: Special eligibility and review/approval rules for construction grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes programmatic, environmental, and design-review processes unique to construction projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Construction-specific Public Policy and Design Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicable construction standards and references (NEPA, flood insurance, historic properties, seismic safety, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, life safety, lab ventilation, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists standards and codes that NIH expects for construction or renovation funded under grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procurement Requirements for Construction Services Under NIH Construction Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Procurement and contracting rules specific to construction services under NIH construction grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes construction management, design-build services, and contract compliance obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equal Employment Opportunity, Labor Standards, and Other Contract Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligations for EEO, labor standards, prevailing wages, contract work hours, and related requirements on construction contracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes non-segregated facilities, Contract Work Hours and Safety Standards Act compliance, liquidated damages, and unclaimed wages disposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Real Property Management Standards for Construction and Alteration Projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for use, disposition, appraisal, and notice of federal interest in real property acquired or improved with NIH funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements for appraisals, insurance, and adherence to federal interest clauses.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Research Service Awards (NRSA) Applicability and Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing NRSA training awards, including eligibility, degree requirements, sponsorship, citizenship, NIH employee rules, and active military duty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed NRSA-specific rules on who may be supported and under what conditions (individual and institutional awards).

rubrics_metrics.name: NRSA Application, Review, Notification, and Period of Support
rubrics_metrics.description: NRSA-specific application processes, review criteria, notification of action, and definitions of period of support (including interruptions and exceptions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes rules for physicians/clinicians, break-in-service handling, and initiation of support.

rubrics_metrics.name: NRSA Financial Provisions (Stipends, Institutional Allowance, Tuition and Fees)
rubrics_metrics.description: NRSA stipend levels, stipend supplementation rules, institutional allowances, allowable costs, tuition/fees treatment, travel to foreign sites, and taxability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details stipend levels by trainee level, institutional cost allowances by institution type, and reporting (1099).

rubrics_metrics.name: NRSA Reporting Procedures and Forms (Activation Notice, Payback Agreement, Termination Notice)
rubrics_metrics.description: NRSA reporting and administrative forms such as Form PHS 2271, PHS 6031 payback, termination notices, and certification processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for appointment statements, payback documentation, and other NRSA administrative reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: NRSA Leave, Termination, Publications, and Intellectual Property
rubrics_metrics.description: NRSA policies on leave (vacation, sick, parental, unpaid), termination of awards, publications, copyrights, patents, and disposition of professional fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies allowable leave, termination procedures, and expectations around dissemination and IP arising from NRSA-supported work.

rubrics_metrics.name: NRSA Human Subjects/Animal Welfare/Recombinant DNA Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements that NRSA-supported activities comply with human subjects, vertebrate animal, and recombinant DNA rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NRSA trainees and institutions must meet the same protections and oversight as other NIH-funded research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payback Reporting Requirements for NRSA Recipients
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing payback obligations for NRSA recipients including definitions, time commitments, initiation, alternative service, financial payback calculation, interest, extensions, waivers, and certification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implementation dates, specific policies for predoctoral/postdoctoral/short-term training, and forms for certification (Form PHS 6031-1).

rubrics_metrics.name: Support of Scientific Meetings (Conference Grants) Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicability, definitions, eligibility, application procedures, public policy requirements, review, funding, allowability of costs, and administrative requirements for conference grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also covers intellectual property for meeting products, reporting and record retention, progress and expenditure reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium Agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for consortium/subaward relationships including written agreements, administrative and other requirements, property and IP handling, program income, audit obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies what must be included in consortium agreements and responsibilities of prime grantee vs consortium partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards to Foreign Institutions and International Organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Special terms for awards to foreign institutions, including eligibility, review, public policy requirements, funding/payment, allowability of costs, admin requirements, and audit/reporting obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also covers domestic grants with substantial foreign components and special administrative processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants to Federal Institutions and Payments to Federal Employees Under Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for grants to federal institutions and payments made to/for federal employees under grants (eligibility, payment, allowability, administrative requirements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes equipment accountability, procurement requirements, and intellectual property rules specific to federal institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants to For-Profit Organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific policies covering grants to for-profit organizations: eligibility, allowability of costs, applicable cost principles, profit or fee, IRAD, F&A, and administrative requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also addresses intellectual property and program-specific rules for commercial entities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) and Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) Programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility, public policy requirements, allowability of costs and fee, profit or fee policies, facilities & administrative costs, market research, program income, and rights in data/inventions/patents for SBIR/STTR awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program-specific rules for small business awards including IP/data rights and commercialization expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Patient Care Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions, policy, allowable costs, computation of research patient care costs, F&A treatment, and special procedures for certain hospitals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on how patient care costs are identified, computed, and charged to NIH awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grantees, Consortium Participants/Contractors under Grants: Financial Responsibilities and Program Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Financial and programmatic responsibilities of grantees, consortium participants, and contractors under NIH grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies roles, responsibilities, and liability among primary recipients and partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendices, Forms, and Schedules (NRSA Financial Provisions, Receipt/Review/Award Schedules, NRSA Forms)
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplementary materials providing detailed financial provisions, schedules, and standardized forms used throughout the policy statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes appendices and exhibits referenced for administration and compliance (e.g., cost estimate outlines).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting to Offices (e.g., Office of Research Integrity) and Other Agencies
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligations to report specific issues to oversight offices and agencies as required (ORI, others).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies which events/violations require external reporting and the appropriate channels.
